title: The integer point enumerator of one irrational translate of P is a complete invariant
summary: For a full-dimensional rational polytope $P\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ and a real dilation parameter $t>0$, the integer point enumerator is defined by $L_{P}(t):= |tP\cap\mathbb{Z}^d|$. We determine exactly which translation vectors $\mathbf y=(y_1,\ldots,y_d)\in\mathbb{R}^d$ have the property that the single translated counting function $t\longmapsto L_{P+\mathbf y}(t)$, with $t\in\mathbb{Q}_{>0}$, uniquely determines $P$ among all full-dimensional rational polytopes in $\mathbb{R}^d$.
